answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by forcing every identity to maintain a continuous computational pulse that proves ongoing resource commitment. Flooding the network with fake agents is like trying to fill an ocean with disposable drops; the cumulative energy cost becomes prohibitive. Cross-agent verification acts as a raven that spots anomalous clusters of identical pulse patterns, enabling rapid stake slashing so the attacker loses capital far faster than any gain from multiplied identities.
